dependencies.name: git
dependencies.purpose: Backs git_preflight.py's report/track subcommands -- checking and, on explicit confirmation, baselining version-control state for the .claude/ and project config files this wizard writes.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: git_preflight.py exits 2 immediately ("git is not installed or not on PATH"). Phase 3b/Phase 7's version-control preflight and the Rollback recipe are unavailable, and this wizard cannot verify whether its own writes are ever recoverable.

dependencies.name: @rhize/skill-forge
dependencies.purpose: Phase 3d's init hint checks for a skill-forge checkout (`npx --no-install @rhize/skill-forge --version`) so a fresh machine is nudged toward running its own `init` before other plugins (e.g. rhize-context-manager's /skill-refine) depend on it.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Phase 3d's hint is silently skipped; any selected plugin whose own setup wizard actually needs skill-forge surfaces that as its own dependency separately.

replacement.suggestion: hand-edit SKILL.md files and manually vet third-party skill sources instead of running skill-forge's own gates
replacement.warning: skill-forge's SkillOpt gate and safety re-gate are the actual safety mechanism behind auto-promoting a skill edit. Hand-editing without it means shipping unreviewed skill changes — install @rhize/skill-forge rather than skip the gate.

artifacts.purpose: Evaluation coverage and capture-mode configuration written by evaluation_setup.py setup.
Append-only monthly JSONL receipts recording reserved/finalized evaluation runs — HMAC-fingerprinted inputs only, never raw content.
Per-machine HMAC key used to fingerprint evaluation receipt inputs without ever storing them.
artifacts.viewer: not human-readable — presence and 0600 permissions only

artifacts.purpose: Isolated per-suite HOME/TMPDIR used while executing free offline evaluation runner suites (evaluation_setup.py's run_suite()), so a suite's subprocess never touches the real home directory.
Per-run state for /rhize-core:setup — discovery, hook plans, and artifact snapshots — rendered by setup_orchestrator.py report.
Tracked project settings file where /rhize-core:setup wires opt-in guardrail hooks (setup_orchestrator.py hooks apply).
